name: Umeme Limited
source: Umeme Limited audited financial statements FY2025 (Ernst & Young Uganda, approved 27 March 2026). Converted UGX -> KES.
source_note: Ushs millions. Audited group statement of financial position as at 31 December 2025 with the 31 December 2024 comparative. Non-current plus current assets equal total assets, and total assets equal total liabilities plus equity, in both years. The 2025 column prints a nil deferred tax asset and no other non-current assets, and no non-current liabilities in either year, so those rows carry the printed nil. This file replaces an earlier row set that carried Umeme total assets under a NGN label from another board.
unit: KES, absolute. Converted from the issuer's Ushs-million figures at 1 UGX = 0.0352 KES (exchange-rates.org, 2024-2025 average); Ushs million x1e6 -> absolute UGX, then -> KES.
